_doc: Declared data gaps (the stale/holed-files guard, engines/data_manager/coverage.py). Each facet excuses exactly what it declares: holed_inside.runs excuse missing trading days inside those runs only; ends_at_delisting excuses an early END only when the file's last bar IS last_bar. Neither excuses the other.
